bookSourceComment:
禁漫天堂 官方原版书源 (基于JM原生API完全重构)
1. 零拦截：直连官方原生 API，彻底摆脱 Cloudflare 5秒盾与拦截弹窗
2. 精确标签：分类、题材、爱心、阅读量原生提取
3. 完整评论：深度提取多级评论与回复 (replys)，层级分明
4. 纯净画质：严格锁定官方图片切片，绝无广告干扰
5. 极速翻页：全站多维筛选发现与无缝翻页

ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
var $java = (this && this.java && typeof this.java.ajax === 'function') ? this.java : ((typeof java !== 'undefined' && typeof java.ajax === 'function') ? java : null);
var data = [];
var res = Getdata(baseUrl, null, $java);
try {
    var obj = JSON.parse(res);
    var list = obj.content || [];
    if (!list.length && obj.id) {
        list = [obj];
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
        var item = list[i];
        var name = item.name;
        var author = String(item.author || "").replace(/(&| & |\||\,|\s)/g, '/').replace(/\/+/g, '/');
        var cat = item.category ? item.category.title : "";
        var subCat = (item.category_sub && item.category_sub.title && item.category_sub.id !== item.category.id) ? item.category_sub.title : "";
        var kind = [cat, subCat].filter(Boolean).join(',');
        var latest = item.update_at ? ("〔" + ($java && typeof $java.timeFormat === 'function' ? $java.timeFormat(String(item.update_at * 1000)) : "") + "〕") : "";
        var intro = item.description || "";
        var cover = imghosts[0] + "/media/albums/" + item.id + "_3x4.jpg";
        var url = "https://www.cdnhjk.net/album?id=" + item.id;
        data.push({
            name: name,
            author: author,
            kind: kind,
            latest: latest,
            intro: intro,
            cover: cover,
            url: url
        });
    }
} catch(e) {
    if ($java && typeof $java.log === 'function') $java.log("ruleSearch error: " + e);
}
data;
</js>
ruleSearch.name: name
ruleSearch.author: author

ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
var $java = (this && this.java && typeof this.java.ajax === 'function') ? this.java : ((typeof java !== 'undefined' && typeof java.ajax === 'function') ? java : null);
var targetUrl = toApiUrl(baseUrl);
var res = Getdata(targetUrl, null, $java);
var list = {};
try {
    list = JSON.parse(res);
} catch(e) {}
if ($java && typeof $java.put === 'function') {
    $java.put("book_raw_" + list.id, JSON.stringify(list));
}

var viewStr = "✦ " + Num(list.total_views);
var likeStr = "♥ " + Num(list.likes);
var tagArr = list.tags || [];
var cat = list.category ? list.category.title : "";
var allTags = [viewStr, likeStr, cat].concat(tagArr).filter(Boolean);
var kindStr = allTags.join(',').replace(/,已/g, ',').replace(/中,/g, ',');

var dateStr = (list.addtime && $java && typeof $java.timeFormat === 'function') ? $java.timeFormat(String(list.addtime * 1000)) : "";
var chapCount = (list.series && list.series.length > 0) ? ("章节数量：" + list.series.length) : "单本短篇";
var headerInfo = "📅 更新时间：" + dateStr + "      🆔 禁漫车号：JM" + list.id + "      📚 " + chapCount;
var desc = list.description ? list.description.trim() : "暂无作品叙述。";

var commentText = formatComments(list.id, 3, $java);
var fullIntro = headerInfo + "\n\n📖【作品叙述】\n" + desc + "\n\n" + commentText;

var latestName = "开始阅读";
if (list.series && list.series.length > 0) {
    latestName = "第" + list.series.length + "章 " + list.series[list.series.length - 1].name;
}

var coverUrl = imghosts[0] + "/media/albums/" + list.id + "_3x4.jpg";

var bookObj = {
    name: list.name,
    author: String(list.author || "").replace(/(&| & |\||\,|\s)/g, '/').replace(/\/+/g, '/'),
    kind: kindStr,
    latest: latestName + (dateStr ? "〔" + dateStr + "〕" : ""),
    intro: fullIntro,
    cover: coverUrl,
    url: targetUrl,
    tocUrl: targetUrl
};
bookObj;
</js>
ruleBookInfo.name: name
ruleBookInfo.author: author

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var $java = (this && this.java && typeof this.java.ajax === 'function') ? this.java : ((typeof java !== 'undefined' && typeof java.ajax === 'function') ? java : null);
var data = [];
var targetUrl = toApiUrl(baseUrl);
var idMatch = targetUrl.match(/id=(\d+)/);
var aid = idMatch ? idMatch[1] : "";
var rawStr = ($java && typeof $java.get === 'function') ? $java.get("book_raw_" + aid) : "";
var list_0 = {};
if (rawStr) {
    try { list_0 = JSON.parse(rawStr); } catch(e) {}
}
if (!list_0.id) {
    try { list_0 = JSON.parse(Getdata(targetUrl, null, $java)); } catch(e) {}
}

var series = (list_0.series && list_0.series.length > 0) ? list_0.series : null;
var date = (list_0.addtime && $java && typeof $java.timeFormat === 'function') ? $java.timeFormat(String(list_0.addtime * 1000)) : "";

if (series && series.length > 0) {
    for (var i = 0; i < series.length; i++) {
        var chap = series[i];
        var title = "第" + (i + 1) + "章 " + chap.name;
        if (i === series.length - 1 && date) {
            title += "〔" + date + "〕";
        }
        data.push({
            title: title,
            link: "https://www.cdnhjk.net/chapter?skip=&id=" + chap.id
        });
    }
} else {
    data.push({
        title: "全一话" + (date ? "〔" + date + "〕" : ""),
        link: "https://www.cdnhjk.net/chapter?skip=&id=" + (list_0.id || aid)
    });
}
data;
</js>
